name: hubtiger_customer_by_phone
description: Fast caller lookup by mobile: customer name plus latest active workshop job (model, jobcard, checked-in date, location). Call once when you have the caller's phone — before job_search for a quick greeting or context. Accepts 04xxxxxxxx, +614xxxxxxxx, or 614xxxxxxxx. Do not read customer_id aloud. If found is false, ask for their mobile again. If hubtiger_timeout, apologize briefly and retry once or continue without names. Never expose raw JSON, trace IDs, or backend errors.

request_body_schema.description:
Lookup Ride Electric / HubTiger customer by Australian mobile.

Provide phone from caller ID, the conversation, or confirmed digits. Use 0412345678 or +61412345678 — server normalizes all AU formats.

If found is true: greet with first_name; you may reference model, jobcard, location, and date_checked_in when relevant to workshop status.

Do not use for booking availability (hubtiger_booking_availability) or full job SMS/notes (hubtiger_job_search + hubtiger_job_retrieve).

Never expose internal diagnostics.

properties.description: Caller mobile number. Australian formats: 04xxxxxxxx, +614xxxxxxxx, or 614xxxxxxxx.
